policy.legacy_capture_status: These two repository-pinned faithful webpage captures and their source-pack.zip predate the local-database-to-Drive webpage default. They remain immutable valid legacy material for this already-started lifecycle and are not a template for new webpage acquisition.
policy.tool_limit_rule: A missing preferred acquisition mechanism may change capture representation but must never justify skipping readable source information.
policy.evidence_boundary: Search snippets and discovery summaries are not source captures. A faithful webpage capture must preserve directly read source content, source identity, capture mode, limitations and a digest of the immutable captured representation. Transport never changes source authority.

source_pack.purpose: Legacy portable immutable packaging of the two faithful captured representations for this already-started lifecycle. The pack digest authenticates the capture package; it does not claim the transcript bytes are byte-identical to the original HTML responses. New readable webpages use bounded local capture DB -> Google Drive by default.

captures.visual_status: Publisher page exposed an image/tracking link that the reader could not fetch. No claim-relevant visual content was confirmed from that link; the limitation is retained rather than silently ignored.
No claim-relevant figure is required for the captured SystImmune alliance section. Unrelated filing graphics remain outside this claim-scoped capture.

temporal_separation.rule: Do not collapse announcement and effectiveness into one sharpened date and do not rewrite sealed memory.
